{{Top|leg}}
'''Blood profession''' was the term give to traditional jobs within [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] society. Blood professions were passed down the Ugnaught family line, generation by generation. In the instance that the available candidates for a blood profession exceeded the number of positions available, a [[blood duel]] was called. A series of fights to the [[Death/Legends|death]] were enacted, with the young Ugnaughts battling for their blood profession. Two of the know blood professions were [[belter]] and [[Tibanna gas panner]].
